ConnectionStrings._comment: Leave empty on first run — the Setup page collects the database connection and writes it to localsettings.json. SQL Server template: Server=.;Database=Dotnetable;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;

Api._comment: The central API instance (default matches Dotnetable.API's dev launchSettings). Admin pushes cache-invalidation calls here right after a write (see Internal:SyncSecret).

Internal._comment: Shared secret with the API's Internal:SyncSecret. OVERRIDE via env var Internal__SyncSecret in production.

Cache._comment: Safety-net TTL for cached read services (Menu/Category/Page/Post); tag invalidation on write keeps entries fresh in practice.
